assignment: Synthetic demonstration: existing UUIDs sorted lexicographically; no verified relationship between Karlsruhe sites and collection history.
selection: All 314 official city sites, then nearest 135 eligible sites among 179 retrieved official Landkreis sites from nine nearby municipalities; regional candidates within 75 m of selected sites excluded. Radius uses straight-line distance solely for site selection, not route costs.

licenses.regional: Official AWB public directory; no open-data reuse license identified; retained with source attribution for this local demonstration.
